svg.title: AdoSQL - Concise architecture
svg.desc: Proposed multi-organization ADO ingestion, normalized SQL data, SKU-to-media/platform mapping, deterministic metrics and grounded LLM issue summaries displayed in the dashboard's rightmost column.
svg.text: Eight ADO stages -> normalized evidence -> SKU mapping -> dashboard + LLM insights
Fixed stage order | each stage has its own ADO organization.
C# Azure Function + ADO Analytics / APIs
Collect stage records, issues and evidence
Common stage / issue schema with source IDs
Preserve test runs and internal / external issues
Map all applicable stages to each SKU
SKU -> media + platform -> upstream test evidence
Retain stage coverage gaps and source links
Which media and platform belong to each SKU?
Use explicit entity IDs and validated mappings
SQL calculates unique issue counts and durations
Combine media, platform and SKU-stage evidence
Ground only in mapped records + SQL metrics
Summarize issue counts, themes and affected stages
SKU dashboard | illustrative output, not live test data
2 media issues in Load and Perf.
Proposed design based on vj926/AdoSQL. Multi-org ingestion, cross-stage mapping and LLM/dashboard are extensions.
Counts and durations come from SQL, not the LLM. Missing evidence stays visible; the rightmost column explains it.
